# Janitor

Original first-person character artwork for LAST LIGHT. The hand, cotton twill sleeve, analog wristwatch, skin pigmentation, textile weave, finger shape keys and game poses were modeled for this project in Blender 4.5 LTS. The editable source is `art/characters/janitor.blend`. Regenerate it and the runtime model with `blender -b -P scripts/model-janitor.py` from the project root.
